{
  "dataset_name": "qsar_biodegradation",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-2.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "is_v1_high",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for whether V1 is above its training set mean (4.77), creating a simple high/low split.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "feature_family": "Indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a direct, interpretable split point for the tree model, simplifying the decision boundary for a key continuous variable.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V1 > 4.7711, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v8_to_v1_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of V8 to V1. This interaction may capture a molecular property density or a relationship not evident from the individual features.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        29.15
      ],
      "feature_family": "Ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a non-linear interaction feature that can capture relationships between variables, which tree models might otherwise need many splits to approximate.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V8 / (V1 + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v12_binned_ordinal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucketing of V12, which has both negative and positive values, into three categories: low (<-1), medium (-1 to 1), and high (>1).",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        2
      ],
      "feature_family": "Ordinal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Discretizes a continuous variable into meaningful regions (negative, near-zero, positive), which can help the tree find more stable and generalizable splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V12 < -1.0, 0, np.where(V12 > 1.0, 2, 1))"
    },
    {
      "name": "rare_feature_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "A count of how many specific rare molecular features are present, based on several low-mean integer columns (V19, V24, V25, V26, V29).",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        5
      ],
      "feature_family": "Count",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates sparse signals into a denser feature, making it easier for the model to detect patterns related to the presence of any rare substructure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V19 > 0).astype(int) + (V24 > 0).astype(int) + (V25 > 0).astype(int) + (V26 > 0).astype(int) + (V29 > 0).astype(int)"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_high_v8_and_zero_v3",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for molecules with a high V8 value (above mean + 1 std deviation) and a V3 value of zero, capturing a specific interaction.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "feature_family": "Interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Explicitly models a specific interaction between two variables, saving the tree from having to discover this two-level split itself.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((V8 > 45.89) & (V3 == 0), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v41_clipped_at_10",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "V41 clipped at a value of 10 to reduce the influence of extreme outliers. The mean is ~0.6 while the max is 27.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        10
      ],
      "feature_family": "Transformed",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Makes the model more robust to extreme outliers in V41 by grouping all high values, preventing a single data point from having undue influence on splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(V41, 0, 10)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v13_minus_v37",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The difference between V13 and V37, which could represent a contrast between two related molecular properties.",
      "value_range": [
        -4.281,
        3.366
      ],
      "feature_family": "Difference",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a new feature representing the relationship between two variables, potentially aligning better with the decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V13 - V37"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_v30_div_v31",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed ratio of V30 to V31 to capture their relationship on a more compressed and stable scale, mitigating the effect of a skewed ratio.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        4.82
      ],
      "feature_family": "Ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Transforms a potentially skewed ratio into a more symmetric distribution, which can improve the stability and performance of tree-based models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(V30 / (V31 + 1e-6))"
    },
    {
      "name": "v22_deviation_from_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of V22 from its training set mean (1.228), highlighting molecules that are atypical on this tightly distributed dimension.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        0.365
      ],
      "feature_family": "Difference",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a 'distance from center' feature that can capture non-monotonic relationships where both very high and very low values are predictive.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(V22 - 1.228)"
    },
    {
      "name": "heavy_atom_indicator_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of several integer-based features (V5, V9, V16, V34) that likely represent counts of different heavy atoms or complex substructures.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        64
      ],
      "feature_family": "Count",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines several related count features into a single, more powerful measure of molecular size or complexity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V5 + V9 + V16 + V34"
    },
    {
      "name": "molecular_profile_group",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A categorical grouping based on V3 and V36 values. Group 1: Low V3 (<1) and high V36 (>4.5). Group 2: High V3 (>2) and low V36 (<3.5). Group 0: Other.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        2
      ],
      "feature_family": "Grouping",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes domain knowledge or observed patterns into a single categorical feature, allowing the model to create a single three-way split on complex conditions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "hydrophobicity_category",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Categorizes molecules based on V1 (SpMax_L) and V12 (LogP), likely related to size and hydrophobicity. 0: Low V1 (<3.5), 1: High V1 (>5.5), 2: High V12 (>1.0), 3: Low V12 (<-1.0), 4: Average.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        4
      ],
      "feature_family": "Grouping",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a multi-level categorical feature based on expert-like rules, which can capture distinct molecular types that are useful for splitting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
